name: Export an agent to CI as a zip, see the install on the CI tab, and open CI Runs from the sidebar
description: Opens the seeded Security Reviewer, goes through the Export to CI wizard (Target, Preview, Configure, Install with 'Copy files as a zip') and checks that the CI tab then lists the repo with its workflow version (AC-12, AC-21, AC-50, AC-94). Then opens CI Runs from the sidebar GLOBAL section and checks the page heading, the Refresh button and the empty state (AC-86, AC-90). The PR variant (AC-49) is RTL/integration-only: this stack talks to real GitHub. Refresh is not clicked here because it would call the real GitHub API. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB with no CI installation (see e2e/README.md); needs the server ci module.
